name: Magickpen
description_en:
MagickPen is an assisted-writing interface where users choose a task, role, subject, language, tone, length and text or Markdown output. It offers Fast and Advanced engines plus templates and optional search/research controls. Role labels do not establish professional expertise or verified factual output.

The current price cards and FAQ contain conflicting paid limits and subscription amounts. The dependable selection questions are which engine consumes which credits, how daily and monthly allowances interact, and what the checkout actually grants. A free daily allowance is separately described.
description_zh:
MagickPen 通过任务、角色、主题、语言、语气、长度及文本/Markdown 设置辅助写作，提供 Fast/Advanced 引擎、模板及搜索/研究选项。角色标签不证明专业资质或事实输出已验证。

现行卡片与 FAQ 的付费限制及金额互相冲突，应重点确认引擎消耗、每日/月额度关系及结账权益，另有免费每日额度。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose subject, role, tone, length and format before drafting.
core_features.explanation_zh: 起草前选择主题、角色、语气、长度和格式。

core_features.explanation_en: Use different engine classes with different credit allowances.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用具有不同额度的引擎类别。

en: Generate a customer email while preserving a supplied deadline and permitted remedy.
zh: 生成客服邮件，同时保留已提供期限及允许方案。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Try a nonconfidential short draft with fixed facts, compare output, then resolve engine credits and price conflicts before paying.
steps.zh: 用固定事实试写非机密短稿、比较输出，付费前解决引擎额度与价格冲突。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Engine-credit subscription or pay-as-you-go packs; daily and monthly limits vary.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free ten credits/day, 500 words/generation. Cards display Basic 6.9, Premium 19, Ultimate 59 monthly with differing Fast/Advanced quotas; FAQ instead says $29 subscription and 3,000 versus card 6,000 words/generation. Billing/currency/trial and current entitlement require clarification; no normalized amount asserted.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 免费每日 10 额度、单次 500 词。卡片月 6.9/19/59，Fast/Advanced 配额不同，FAQ 又称 $29 订阅，单次 3,000 与卡片 6,000 词冲突。需澄清账期、币种、试用和权益，不填标准化金额。

sources.title: MagickPen - AI Writing Assistant, powered by ChatGPT
sources.research_notes_en: Template/role/language/tone/length/format writing with Fast/Advanced engines; model label not independently resolved.

sources.title: Pricing - MagickPen
sources.research_notes_en: Basic/Premium/Ultimate cards conflict with older FAQ subscription price and generation length; free daily ten credits/five-hundred words, paygo refund distinct.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Supply the facts instead of only selecting a role
sections.title_zh: 提供事实，不只选择角色
sections.en: For an illustrative customer email, include the actual return deadline, product name and allowed resolution, then choose tone and output format. Review dates, amounts and promises afterwards. A lawyer or doctor role label does not create a qualified adviser, and web-search or research switches do not independently verify the generated answer. No prompt, model call or source-link test was executed.
sections.zh: 例如客服邮件，应提供真实退货期限、产品名和允许解决方案，再选语气与格式，之后核对日期、金额和承诺。律师或医生角色不形成合格顾问，搜索/研究开关也不独立验证答案。本文未执行提示、模型调用或来源链接测试。

sections.title_zh: 解决卡片与 FAQ 冲突
sections.en: Cards show Basic 6.9/month with unlimited Fast credits, Premium 19 with 600 Advanced credits/month and twenty/day, and Ultimate 59 with 1,800/month and sixty/day. The same page’s older FAQ says a $29 unlimited subscription. Cards promise up to 6,000 words/generation while the FAQ says 3,000. Do not combine the most favorable figures; confirm selected plan, currency, billing and maximum input/output before purchase.
sections.zh: 卡片显示 Basic 月 6.9、不限 Fast，Premium 19、月 600 Advanced/日 20，Ultimate 59、月 1,800/日 60；同页旧 FAQ 又称 $29 不限订阅。卡片承诺单次 6,000 词，FAQ 却称 3,000。不能拼接最优惠数字，应购买前确认方案、币种、账期及输入/输出上限。

sections.title_en: Separate recurring free credits from paid conditions
sections.title_zh: 区分免费每日额度与付费条件
sections.en: The free-user notice says ten credits/day with a 500-word generation limit. A seven-day paid-feature trial is also advertised; renewal and eligibility were not resolved. FAQ pay-as-you-go packs are described as nonexpiring, with a refund request condition below ten-percent usage within thirty days. Subscriptions instead say no refund and cancellation effective at cycle end. These descriptions need current checkout/policy confirmation.
sections.zh: 免费说明为每日 10 额度、单次 500 词，另宣传七天付费功能试用，续费及资格未确定。FAQ 称按量包不过期，三十天内使用低于 10% 可申请退款；订阅则不退款、取消到期生效，均需现行结账/政策确认。

sections.title_en: Use it for drafts with measurable acceptance checks
sections.title_zh: 用可核验标准验收初稿
sections.en: MagickPen may suit exploring short drafts or translations with detailed instructions. Verify the intended platform/download, history, confidential-data handling and export before operational use. It is not established as a self-hosted or open-source product. No language-quality, engine accuracy, time saving, refund or search-result claim was independently tested.
sections.zh: 可用详细指令探索短稿或翻译，运营使用前需核对目标平台/下载、历史、机密数据及导出。本次未确认自托管或开源，也未独立测试语言质量、引擎准确性、节时、退款或搜索结果。

research_gaps: No generation, search, research, download, translation, payment, trial or refund was tested.
Conflicting price/word limits, selected billing, engine-credit accounting, privacy, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
